title: Automate your recruiting pipeline
description: Source candidates, score them against your scorecard, write up interviews, and keep everyone in the loop.
introduction: Picture a recruiter who finds the people a keyword search misses, checks every applicant against your scorecard, writes up each interview, and makes sure no candidate waits too long for a reply. That's what Strawberry can become for your talent team.
ChatGPT and Claude can explain how to source. Strawberry does the sourcing. It's a free browser with an AI companion built in, working inside LinkedIn, your ATS, and Slack, logged in as you.

demo.title: Product Designer interview
lines: You: Tell me about a design call you'd make differently now.
Alex: Our onboarding. We shipped it before talking to enough users.
You: What did you change after launch?
Alex: We cut it from five steps to two and started weekly user calls.

2 open questions for the next round

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: Chatbots only know what you paste in. Strawberry works where your candidates are.

items: Uses LinkedIn and your ATS while you're logged in.
Reads dozens of profiles at once, not one click at a time.
Works in real tabs you can watch and take over.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

items: Check your ATS every Monday and see which role needs sourcing most.
Calibrate on two or three mock candidates before any real search.
Tighten a job description against what the scorecard actually needs.
Write outreach that sounds like you, specific to each person.
Pin a candidate dashboard as a tab, with photos, notes, and what you care about.

blocks.text: Save your scorecard and sourcing rules as a team skill and every recruiter's companion searches the same way, including whoever joins next. Put the steady parts on Routines and the Monday pipeline review and candidate check-ins happen even in your busiest weeks.
